canonical_project: STISC national Tier III AI-ready data center - Ungheni site-search candidate
owner: Serviciul Tehnologia Informatiei si Securitate Cibernetica (STISC)
notes: STISC 2025 activity report (A-grade official) records a feasibility study for a new Tier III AI-ready national data center and land-identification trips to Ungheni district, Falesti district and Balti municipality; the feasibility-study procurement was launched then cancelled pending a revised concept. As of 2026-08-12 no public evidence that Ungheni was finally selected or that permits/MW capacity exist - recorded as planned/site-search candidate per methodology (final site not public). MCloud is a government cloud platform, not a new physical facility.
